title: 第3章 若有来世，他要换个活法-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》
content:
第(1/3)页

    陈建国的脸黑得像锅底，但他当着这么多人面，到底没有发作。

    赵素梅攥着那两万块钱，手在发抖。

    两万块。

    加上林静的两千、林薇的三千，再加上她自己从娘家借来的五千，一共也才三万。

    还差五万。

    她抬头看了看门口那些人，那些人也都看着她。

    目光交汇的一瞬间，她心里最后那点希望彻底熄灭了。

    那些人的眼神她看懂了。

    不是没钱，是不想给。

    不是不知道，是不在乎。

    林国强把这一切看在眼里，心里反而平静了。

    那种平静很奇怪，像是在狂风暴雨的中心，反而有一小块地方是安静的。

    他想起了很多事，想起了小时候过年，他把鸡腿让给弟弟妹妹，自己啃鸡爪子。

    想起了退伍回来，他把安置费借给老三娶媳妇。

    想起了分家的时候，他把好地让给大哥，自己分了一块河滩边的薄田。

    赵素梅跟他吵了一架，三天没跟他说话……

    他想起赵素梅跟他的时候，才二十一岁，扎着两条麻花辫，笑起来有两个酒窝。

    那时候她多好看啊，眼睛亮亮的，像春天里刚化开的河水。

    可现在呢？

    她现在是什么样子？

    头发花白，眼角布满皱纹，手上全是裂口和老茧，指甲缝里永远洗不掉的泥土。

    她才四十五岁，看起来却像五六十岁的人。

    她这辈子跟着他，没过过一天好日子。

    而他呢？

    他把一切都给了别人，把苦和累留给了自己和妻女。

    他以为他是好人。

    其实他是天底下最大的混蛋。

    他对得起所有人，唯独对不起最该对得起的人。

    林国强突然笑了。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Chen Jianguo’s face was as dark as the bottom of a pot, but he didn’t have an attack in front of so many people.

Zhao Sumei clutched the 20,000 yuan, her hands trembling.

Twenty thousand yuan.

“ Adding in Lin Jing’s two thousand, Lin Wei’s three thousand, plus the five thousand she borrowed from her parents’ family, the total is only thirty thousand.

There’s still fifty thousand left.

She looked up at the people at the door, and they all looked at her.

The moment their eyes met, the last bit of hope in her heart was completely extinguished.

She understood the look in those people’s eyes.

It’s not that I don’t have money, it’s that I don’t want to give it.

It’s not that I don’t know, it’s that I don’t care.

Lin Guoqiang saw all this and felt calm in his heart.

That kind of calmness is strange, like in the center of a violent storm, there is a small area of ​​quietness.

He remembered a lot of things. He recalled that during the Chinese New Year when he was a child, he would give the chicken legs to his younger siblings and gnaw on the chicken feet himself.

Thinking of returning from the army, he lent the resettlement fee to the third child to get a wife.

Recalling the time when the family was separated, he gave up the good land to his eldest brother and allocated a piece of thin land by the river beach to himself.

Zhao Sumei had a quarrel with him and didn’t speak to him for three days...

He remembered that when Zhao Sumei was with him, she was only twenty-one years old, with two braids and two dimples when she smiled.

How beautiful she was at that time, her eyes were as bright as the newly melted river water in spring.

But what about now?

What does she look like now?

My hair is gray, the corners of my eyes are covered with wrinkles, my hands are full of cracks and calluses, and there is dirt between my fingernails that can never be washed away.

She is only forty-five years old, but she looks like someone in her fifties or sixties.

She has never had a good day following him in her life.

And what about him?

He gave everything to others, leaving the pain and tiredness to himself, his wife and daughter.

He thought he was a good person.

In fact, he is the biggest bastard in the world.

He was worthy of everyone, but he was sorry to the people who deserved it the most.

Lin Guoqiang suddenly laughed.
